Princess Gardens

This is another tune I’ve picked up from YouTube videos of Brian Finnegan. I don’t know if he wrote it or not, but I think it’s really pretty!

Here he is, playing it at learner speed: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8mE9khrYJ1s
(I know there is at least one video of him playing it at full tempo, but I came across it ages ago, and now I can’t find it.)

Castlerock Road by Damien O’Kane

There’s a been a bit of confusion about the title of this tune. It’s definitely Castlerock Road, and not Princess Gardens.

I got an email from Damien O’Kane (who composed the tune) and he clarified:

“I recorded it on ‘The Mystery Inch’ album with David Kosky a few years back and it has been recorded by numerous others since then such as Brian Finnegan. It says on here that it is also known as ‘Princess Gardens’ but this is not the case. Princess Gardens is a completely different tune i also wrote and recorded on The Mystery Inch.”

↳ Posted by Jeremy on July 21st, 2013.

Re: Castlerock Road

I was there in that video of Brian Finnegan at the top, he was teaching to a group of whistle players at the Burwell Summer School.
At that time it was a very new tune titled Princess Gardens after the street in Coleraine. It was subsequently published and recorded under the name Castlerock Road, also in Coleraine, the road off which Princess Gardens is situated.
To me, it will always be Princess Gardens!

↳ Posted by Simon Styles on September 24th, 2024.
